content.title: About
content.content: Strawberry milk with low fat (1%) is a beverage made from skimmed cow's milk and natural strawberry puree. It offers a smooth creamy taste with a bright berry note, contains minimal fat, and is suitable for those watching their calorie intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Strawberry milk is often used in children's nutrition because of its mild flavor and high digestibility.
Strawberries are rich in vitamin C, which remains stable in milk when processed correctly.
Skimmed milk retains most nutrients while providing lower calories compared to whole milk.
In some countries strawberry milk is a seasonal product, appearing in stores during spring and summer.
The strawberry aroma is achieved without artificial flavors, using only natural extract or puree.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Strawberries provide vitamin C, supporting the immune system and enhancing iron absorption.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: At 1 % fat, the drink fits well into low‑calorie and low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Milk supplies calcium essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Protein
items.content: Skimmed milk retains about 3 g of protein per 100 ml, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Probiotics (when fortified)
items.content: Some strawberry milk varieties are fortified with probiotics that support gut health.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: As with any cow's milk, it may cause discomfort for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to casein or whey should avoid this product.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Some versions contain added sugars; those monitoring blood glucose should check the label.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidity of strawberries can increase the risk of tooth enamel erosion with frequent consumption.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Strawberry milk can be enjoyed on its own, added to smoothies, cereals, oatmeal, used in baking, or as a base for sauces and desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. After opening, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
